// diagnostic E0901

Jet.MissingGenericBound

Method needs a generic bound

What

Method needs a generic bound

Why

A method on a generic type can only use what the type parameter's bound promises

Fix

Add the required generic bound to the method.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MissingGenericBound: Tests/UI/type_needs_bound.stderr.

Error: Jet.MissingGenericBound: Calling `name` needs `Named`
  --> Tests/UI/type_needs_bound.jet:5:30
    |
  5 | greet: fn<T>(x: T) { print(x.name()) }
    |                              ^^^^
 Why: Methods on a type parameter require that bound
 Fix: Add `<T: Named>` to the generic parameter list
